title: Locksmith at 2 a.m.
synopsis: You answer the after-hours line. The voice is small and far away.

nodes.text: An older woman locked out. She is on her front porch. It is freezing. Both choices lead to Driveway, but “Drive over” arrives there with a different cost than “Try to walk her through it.”

choices.consequence: You choose to drive over. It opens the route to Driveway, giving up the protection of pretending you had not decided.

choices.text: Try to walk her through it
choices.consequence: You commit to try to walk her through it. By Driveway, the choice has already shifted who trusts you and who begins to watch.

nodes.text: She is wearing slippers. Her cat is, somehow, in the bushes. The Lock comes either way; its meaning changes with the difference between “Cat first” and “Door first.”

choices.consequence: You commit to cat first. By The Lock, the choice has already shifted who trusts you and who begins to watch.
You choose to door first. It opens the route to The Lock, giving up the protection of pretending you had not decided.

nodes.text: Old. Cantankerous. Two minutes of patience. Inside will follow either decision, but it will meet a different version of you after “Take your time” than after “Force it.”

choices.consequence: You take your time. The decision moves you toward Inside and tells everyone present what you are willing to risk.
You commit to force it. By Inside, the choice has already shifted who trusts you and who begins to watch.

nodes.text: She turns on a kettle. Apologizes ten times. You wave her off. Both choices lead to Photo, but “Stay for tea” arrives there with a different cost than “Decline, gentle.”

choices.consequence: You commit to stay for tea. By Photo, the choice has already shifted who trusts you and who begins to watch.
You decline, gentle. The decision moves you toward Photo and tells everyone present what you are willing to risk.

nodes.text: On the mantel, a young woman in uniform. She tells you about her daughter. Both choices lead to Drive Home, but “Listen” arrives there with a different cost than “Note the time, leave.”

choices.consequence: You choose to listen. It opens the route to Drive Home, giving up the protection of pretending you had not decided.
You note the time, leave. The decision moves you toward Drive Home and tells everyone present what you are willing to risk.

nodes.text: Dawn over the highway. You decide what kind of next month you want. “Bring more presence to it” draws you toward Your Route; “Take a different shift” leaves Morning, On waiting on the other side.

choices.consequence: You choose to bring more presence to it. It opens the route to Your Route, giving up the protection of pretending you had not decided.
You commit to take a different shift. By Morning, On, the choice has already shifted who trusts you and who begins to watch.

nodes.text: You become her once-a-month phone friend. You change a lightbulb for her sometimes. She bakes. The road into Your Route began with “Bring more presence to it” in Drive Home; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.

You go home, sleep four hours, eat pancakes. You feel, for an unrelated reason, hopeful. The road into Morning, On began with “Take a different shift” in Drive Home; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.
